title: Fix the quoting bugs of a POSIX sh file script
notes: skill: shell quoting; make a seeded /bin/sh script (collect *.EXT with a TAB manifest, move files named in a list file, or rename by suffix) safe for any file name without changing its behaviour; run by /bin/sh with a restricted PATH on hidden name sets in private dirs, comparing the whole resulting tree (and stdout); traps: unquoted expansions, for-in-$(ls), ls/cp/mv/basename on a leading-dash name, glob chars matching other files ([ab].txt vs a.txt), macOS sh echo expanding backslashes, the no-match glob, read without IFS=/-r and the list's last line without a newline, TABs in names and spaced dirs (knob); pass_guess_permille: 450
